entries.title: Editing keys in the message box
entries.body: The message box and card replies now take a few editing keys. Control-U removes the text before the cursor on its line, Control-K the text after it, Control-W the word before it, and Control-Y puts back what you removed. Control-P in an empty message box brings back your last message, like the Up arrow. The usual Mac shortcuts work as before.
entries.noPicture: A picture cannot show a key press, and the message box looks the same.
